versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No functional or behavioral changes to core logic.
- Documentation and project structure remain unchanged.

Version 1.0.0 – Initial release of the 《红楼梦》人物关系图谱 skill.

- Provides a knowledge graph on relationships between characters in 《红楼梦》.
- Requires manual API key setup; prompts user for API key if missing and saves it.
- Includes clear workflow for routing user intentions to appropriate backend tools.
- Supports two main functions: fetching the graph schema and executing read Cypher queries.
- Ensures all data comes from the configured API; never invents or searches for data without a key.
